name: Kandarp Digi Smart BPO Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2001, Kandarp Digi Smart 
BPO Ltd provides BPO support services & solutions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KDS, part of Reliable Data Services Limited, operates in the Business Process Outsourcing sector, providing 24-hour B2B corporate call center services through its 39 branches across India. The company was a pioneer in introducing PDA-based technology and Android applications for Credit Support Services.

cons: Stock is trading at 5.57 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 7.50% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 224 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -11.1%
